meaning:
ἄλευρον, -ου, τό

elsewhere.note: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
